title: LEGHO
tagline: Send & Receive GHO between frens with Legho, a payment mobile dapp for your social events.
description:
LEGHO is an easy-to-use mobile application for Web2 and Web3 frens who want to share event costs, divide joint expenses or quickly pay off debts by using GHO tokens.

**What problem is Legho designed to solve?**

LEGHO meets the need to use GHO tokens in a concrete use case, that of payment between frens, and in particular with users who are not necessarily in Web3, by leveraging account abstraction.

**User experience**

- Connect your wallet with Family
- Scan QR address to pay your frens
- Select token & get an estimation in GHO
- Send GHO to your frens without the need to sign transaction (leveraging account abstraction)

**Features**

- Plan your social event with frens
- Manage your portfolio and expenses
- Send & Receive GHO between frens

**Roadmap**

- Face ID signature by using the secp256r1 elliptic curve to sign with modern devices
- Include token change in order to automate the change of token in GHO into the contract
- Possibility to create customizable link that you can share with your frens for payments
- Accept on-ramp payments to buy GHO with credits cards and bank transfers into the dapp
